title: New balance - Made in USA 990v6 $199 Delivered (was $320) / $0 C&C / In-Store @ New Balance
body:
Deal: New balance - Made in USA 990v6 $199 Delivered (was $320) / $0 C&C / In-Store @ New Balance

[Ez4menotu] Sign up to their Newsletter is 15% off on top and unidays student verification is 15% off. Not stackable. Brings the price down to $169
[newopolarfan1] thanks for that code! really tempting price but I have enough shoes as it is 😬 just to take into account how good this price is, you'd have a difficult time finding a lightly used pair at this price. a shame no half sizes are available though
[Lukepara] no, generally means more expensive and lower quality
[Penalty boxer] Does it help if it's made in the USA by Chinese and Mexican immigrants?
[boomramada] I bought this before; it's super comfy and lasts longer than the typical one. It's just that the design is a bit boring.
[Kai4039] This one run long and narrow, worst possible combo, wide feets aware
[tof] Agreed. Even going up half a size is super tight just behind the toes.
[CRCinAU] Why are NB shoes so expensive? I bought a pair and less than 4 months later, the entire sole is about worn through.
I've had longer lasting shoes that were $15 from KMart :(
[Brick50] Signed up to newsletter, any idea how long for 15% off code?
